correctness.rationale: For connected simple undirected G, degree leaders maximize neighbor count and eigenvector leaders maximize the positive Perron eigenvector. The unique-maximizer qualifier excludes tied cases. The packaged exact method computes p(t)=det(tI−A), q_i(t)=det(tI−A with vertex i removed), and q_i(λ)=p′(λ)x_i²/||x||² at simple largest eigenvalue λ, comparing q_i(λ) via rational Sturm root isolation. Examined the actual verifier implementing these exact comparisons, and independently enumerated ALL connected unlabeled networkx Graph Atlas representatives of n=2,..,7 with counts 1,2,6,21,112,853; a separate symmetric eigensolver found no distinct singleton leaders through n=6 and exactly 5 seven-vertex classes with the five same edge-list representatives and leader pairs. Gaps in detected distinct-leader cases were comfortably away from numerical tie threshold; exact Sturm source method, not numerical approximation alone, supports precise ties. Explicitly enumerated all 7! vertex relabelings of those 5 representatives, confirming automorphism orders 12,2,2,4,2 and orbit sizes 420,2520,2520,1260,2520 totaling 9240. Graph Atlas completeness externally documented; atlas enumeration is finite exhaustive for order≤7, not an infinite graph theorem.
